channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: "I've a whole new sort of hunger for it after the few months away last year"
item.description: After missing out on the majority of last year's inter-county season, Fermanagh's Brenda Bannon has come into 2026 with a renewed appetite and an added layer of responsibility.

item.title: UL find extra gear to set-up Sigerson Cup final date with UCC
item.description: University of Limerick will play UCC in the Sigerson Cup final next Wednesday at Croke Park (7.35pm) after coming through an epic semi-final against Queen's University, Belfast last night.

item.title: Waterlogged pitch sees Armagh-Cork Ladies NFL clash postponed
item.description: Tomorrow afternoon's Lidl National Football League Division 1 clash between Armagh and Cork has been postponed.

item.title: Kerry cruise to second win in Division 2 as Derry get off the mark
item.description: Kerry remain unbeaten in Division 2 of the Allianz Hurling League after three rounds thanks to a 5-21 to 1-21 victory against London at Austin Stack Park this afternoon.

item.title: Sligo and Longford continue winning ways in Division 4
item.description: Sligo and Longford maintained their 100% records in Division 4 of the Allianz Hurling League with respective victories this afternoon.

item.title: Roscommon comfortably see off Armagh for second win in Division 3
item.description: Roscommon made it back-to-back wins in the Allianz Hurling League Division 3 by defeating Armagh on a comprehensive 2-17 to 0-12 scoreline at BOX-IT Athletic Grounds this afternoon.

item.title: Ladies: Waterford keep up impressive form to deal Dublin third straight loss
item.description: Waterford continued their perfect start to the Lidl National Ladies Football League with a deserved five-point victory against All-Ireland champions Dublin in Dungarvan.

item.title: Chin returns as Wexford produce strong finish to see off plucky Carlow
item.description: Wexford came through a tough battle with neighbours Carlow at Chadwicks Wexford Park this evening to chalk up their third win in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Rebels finish strong to inflict first league loss on Tipp
item.description: Cork produced a strong finish to see off Tipperary by 0-29 to 0-22 tonight and claim their third consecutive in Division 1A of the Allianz Hurling League.
